PA-00059-01.note: All three lines bill 1 week of A.16.010 at S-05 on DW-00004 (week beginning Mon 10/02/2025, 7 days on, signed both; >=5 days so measurable, Sch 5 note / 47A). Clause 44's test is same item, work area and date: the stated dates differ (10, 11, 15 Feb), so literally no line is a duplicate and each is payable; but the record evidences one week only, and if the date of a weekly measurement is its week the three are the same measurement and only the first is payable. 'Later' is not defined: by work date PA-00309-05 is first, by submission PA-00431 (28 Feb) is first, by application number PA-00059 is first.
